theme_strategy.description: Premium cinematic dark mode avoiding pure black. Inspired by Netflix and modern SaaS (Vercel/Godly-tier). Uses deep midnight slate for backgrounds and crisp white/desaturated cyan for accents to reduce eye strain while retaining a luxury vibe.

rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Stick to the HSL tokens.
Gradients are allowed for backgrounds but must be subtle and premium. Keep them low-opacity radial or linear gradients that enhance depth without overpowering content.
Always set text colors explicitly on hover states.

typography.strategy: The 'Editorial Future' pairing. High contrast between wide display sans and ultra-clean geometric body.

surface_styles.interactive_card: transition-transform duration-300 ease-out hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl hover:border-primary/50

hero_paste_input.layout: Massive central focal point. No standard borders.
hero_paste_input.style: h-20 md:h-24 text-2xl md:text-3xl bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl px-8 shadow-2xl focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-primary focus-within:border-primary transition-colors duration-300

motion.hover: Never use 'transition: all'. Use 'transition-transform duration-300 ease-out' or 'transition-colors duration-200'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text overlaid on video thumbnails has a text-shadow or a dark gradient behind it. Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus-visible:ring-2).
accessibility.motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'. Add fallbacks to opacity transitions instead of translations if enabled.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js or .jsx extensions for React components. Do not use .tsx.
CRITICAL: Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='paste-input', data-testid='preview-btn').
CRITICAL: Do NOT center-align the app container. Remove '.App { text-align: center; }' from CSS.
CRITICAL: Never use 'transition: all' as it breaks transforms. Use 'transition-transform duration-300 ease-out' or 'transition-colors duration-200'.
CRITICAL: Import Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' in index.css.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for floating navigation or overlays over content; always use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent bg.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications for states like 'Link copied' or 'Download started'.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-React for crisp iconography.
Ensure the hero link input feels massive, frictionless, and inviting.
Theme: Prefer dark mode layout default, ensuring the user feels immersed in a cinematic environment.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
